rows.statement: Guideline citation: ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT 2022 clinical practice guideline updates IPF and defines progressive pulmonary fibrosis in adults.

source.title: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (an Update) and Progressive Pulmonary Fibrosis in Adults: Official ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT Clinical Practice Guideline

rows.statement: For non-IPF ILD with radiological fibrosis, PPF requires at least 2 of 3 domains within 1 year without alternative explanation; physiologic thresholds are absolute FVC decline ≥5 percentage points or hemoglobin-corrected DLCO decline ≥10 percentage points predicted.

source.title: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (an Update) and Progressive Pulmonary Fibrosis in Adults: Official ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT Clinical Practice Guideline

rows.statement: In IPF, an FVC decline of 2–6% predicted is an estimated clinically important difference.
